author: benjaminion
content: I hear you, but ACD is interactive and synchronous: i think that is valuable and I don't plan to change it. Maybe async input is ok for minor decisions, but potentially DFIing a headliner is huge - we need to let it soak. If it becomes clear on the call that the mood is _not_ to DFI it, than that's an easier decision (basically status quo), and maybe we can just do that. We'll see.

author: draganrakita
content:
In past, ACD was shown as a not optimal or even not good medium to express various opinions on multiple parties. To much parties and you have one speaker at the time. It came down on who is loudest and who speaks the most.

In today world of clankers, aggregating various and multiple data point into one summary is easy to do. So leaving arguments for or agains the topic, making risks assessments or finding priorities to the work is easier to do async before talks even start. Live talk is useful, but leaving async notes is helping that interaction
